name: kluster.ai
description_en:
kluster.ai is a product in the AI coding category. Its directory profile covers Documentation Assitance, Code Linting, IDE Integration, Context-Aware Code, Error Logs, Security and Privacy Compliance, Multi Programming Languages, Code Completion.

Additional listed capabilities include Collaboration Tools. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $10.00. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: suggest code while it is being written; support shared work and communication between participants. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出协作工具。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $10.00. 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在编写过程中提供代码补全建议；支持多人共同工作和沟通。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
